verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents invoice/bill payment and 'approval flows' automation for global vendor bills (jeeves-docs-27, 28) plus expense/spend controls, permissions, and audit trails (jeeves-docs-20, 22, 29), which together imply a bill-upload-to-approval-to-pay flow. However there is no dedicated documentation of a bill-upload feature or a configurable multi-step approval workflow engine (e.g., approval chains, thresholds, sign-off UI) — only a brief marketing mention of 'approval flows' with no detail. Missing for 10: explicit bill/invoice upload mechanism, detailed approval-workflow configuration (multi-step, role-based sign-off), and independent/hands-on confirmation that the workflow functions before payment.
